Create a premium live-action cinematic photograph of one clearly adult East Asian woman leaning forward onto a windowsill, her torso angled toward the camera as she gazes upward into a stream of soft light. Soft, warm overhead light washes her upturned face and shoulders, catching the pendant and individual hair strands while falling gently into the dim interior. Preserve natural shadows, smooth highlight roll-off, visible pores, subtle skin variation, and lifelike material reflections. Shoot on a full-frame camera with a 50 mm prime lens at f/1.8, focused on her eyes. Use shallow depth of field, slight organic softness near the frame edges, and rich but restrained cinematic color with deep muted shadows.

Raw live-action realism; no artificial skin smoothing, CGI, illustration, anime styling, text, logo, or watermark.
